## Purpose
This is the root of the `codecontext` Claude Code plugin — an LLM-driven auto-documentation system that generates per-directory `AUTO_DOCS.md` files and cross-file "system design" manifests for any host repo, keeping them fresh via post-push hooks.

## Map
- Plugin manifest (capabilities, judge config, host-repo contract) → `plugin.json`
- Installation guide (plugin path, submodule path, bootstrap commands) → `INSTALL.md`

## Subdirectories
- `docgen/` — generates per-directory `AUTO_DOCS.md` via `claude -p`, detects staleness by content hash, and injects docs as PreToolUse context. See `docgen/README.md`.
- `systems-registry/` — full lifecycle for cross-file system manifests: heuristic detection → LLM hypothesis → body generation → vet/revise → judge scoring → inject hook + static site. See `systems-registry/README.md`.
- `hooks/` — two event-driven scripts: `auto-docs-refresh.mjs` (PostToolUse, runs docgen + sysreg on PR/push) and `reset-inject-dedup.mjs` (clears per-session dedup state on compaction). See `hooks/README.md`.
- `scripts/` — installation utilities: `install.sh` wires the plugin into a host repo, `merge-settings.mjs` idempotently merges hook config, `safe-pr-create.sh` wraps `gh pr create` non-blocking. See `scripts/README.md`.
- `telemetry/` — append-only JSONL event log (`~/.claude-telemetry/`) recording every hook firing; `writer.mjs` is the write API, `cli.mjs` is the viewer. See `telemetry/README.md`.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- Host repo's `.claude/settings.json` — `scripts/install.sh` and `merge-settings.mjs` merge hook entries here
- `docs/systems/` — all `systems-registry` pipeline output lives here in the host repo
- `claude -p` subprocess — default judge/generator for both `docgen` and `systems-registry`; overrideable via `DOCGEN_JUDGE_CMD` / `SYSREG_JUDGE_CMD`

## Gotchas
- The two distribution models (plugin path vs. submodule/clone path) use different hook path conventions: plugin mode uses `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` references; vendored mode uses `tools/codecontext/` relative paths. Merging the wrong `hooks/settings.json` into a host repo silently mis-routes hooks.
- `AUTO_DOCS.md` is the only file docgen writes — never `README.md`. Code expecting docs must look for `AUTO_DOCS.md`.
- After install, all refresh is fully automated via the PostToolUse hook; manual bootstrapping (`docgen --until-done --parallel 4` + `cli.mjs run`) is only needed once.
